summary: Tested 'Promote hashtag -> Featured Interest Card' backend + frontend. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering promote (incl. idempotency), public list, reorder, delete (incl. 404), analytics, 403 on every founder-gated endpoint for normal user, copyright queue gate, and storage status regression (uploads_root=/data/ourrealm, persistent_configured=true). Frontend: verified /interests page in guest mode renders the FEATURED badge on Music and Crypto static cards after backend promotions (confirms GET /api/hashtags/interest-cards + Home.jsx buildFeaturedCards/featuredIds badge merge). /admin/hashtags and /admin/analytics correctly show denied / sign-in-required states for unauthenticated users. Interactive admin login flow could not be completed via Playwright because the welcome landing-page 'SIGN IN' pill renders as an icon-only div (empty innerText) without a stable selector, so the promote/reorder/remove click-through and the Copyright Queue UI were validated only at the backend level + data-testid presence-in-source-code level (greps confirmed all expected testids exist in AdminHashtags.jsx, Home.jsx and AdminAnalytics.jsx).

issues: 'SIGN IN' / 'SIGN UP' / 'BROWSE AS GUEST' pills have no data-testid and the buttons return empty innerText to Playwright (icon-only), making them brittle to automate. Suggest adding data-testid=landing-signin-button (and signup/guest) so future tests can drive the auth flow.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid to the 3 pills on the Welcome landing page so the testing agent can sign in headlessly and exercise the full promote -> reorder -> remove click path on /admin/hashtags.

Manual re-test recommended (or main-agent self-test via apiClient pre-seeded localStorage token) for the interactive parts: clicking admin-hashtags-promote-<tag> moves the row to featured-card-<tag>, featured-up-/down-/remove-<label> all work, and Copyright Queue resolve/hide/keep buttons fire the moderation action endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/hashtags.py promote-to-interest correctly uses unique index on label for idempotency and assigns next sort_order from max() — clean.
DELETE /interest-cards/{label} correctly normalises label (lstrip #, lower) and returns 404 when missing.

AdminHashtags.jsx & AdminAnalytics.jsx & Home.jsx all expose the data-testids called out in the spec (featured-interest-cards, featured-card-<label>, featured-up/down/remove-<label>, admin-hashtags-promote-<tag>, section-featured, interest-<id>-featured-badge, copyright-queue-card with status filter and per-report action buttons).
Welcome landing page (root '/') is missing data-testid hooks on its primary CTAs (Sign In / Sign Up / Browse as Guest); blocking automated end-to-end UI tests.

success_rate.frontend: partial — guest-side /interests badge verified visually; interactive admin click-through not exercised due to login selector gap

test_credentials: Founder stealth/Password1$ and user tfone/pass1234 — both valid against /api/auth/login (verified by backend pytest fixtures).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests left these interest cards seeded: music + crypto (memes/temptag were created then deleted during cleanup). These persist in db.interest_cards and are visible on the public /interests page as featured badges on the static Music/Crypto cards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for this feature lives at /app/backend/tests/test_promote_interest_cards.py (18 tests, all green). To drive the admin UI in Playwright you need to first land on '/', then click the 'SIGN IN' pill which is currently an icon-only button without data-testid — either add a testid in LandingPage or set the auth cookie programmatically before navigating to /admin/hashtags. After login the page renders with data-testid=admin-hashtags-page and the featured section is data-testid=featured-interest-cards. Promote rows are data-testid=admin-hashtags-promote-<tag> and featured rows are data-testid=featured-card-<label> with featured-up-/down-/remove-<label> action buttons.
rca of the issue: Not a bug — feature works. The only friction is testability: the welcome landing page's primary auth CTAs lack data-testid, so headless end-to-end admin tests need either added testids or programmatic token injection.
